item.title: VISA
item.description: Bhutan follows a regulated visa and tourism system Obtaining a visa for Bhutan involves a specific process, and Bhutan has a unique approach to tourism to preserve its culture and environment. Tourists are required to book their travel through an authorized tour operator, and the tour operator will handle the visa application process on your behalf. Here’s an overview of the visa processing procedure for Bhutan: Choose a Licensed Tour Operator To visit Bhutan, you must book your trip through a licensed Bhutanese tour operator.
